provenance: Independently authored by an independent test-case author after reviewing frozen adapter commit 168eee7a1fad8133ea4caa36f476bc1bd6f81f47. Inputs and handwritten expected answers were derived from the unchanged PRD and fictional catalog, without model outputs. The owner/implementer remained blind to this new fixture before actual evaluation. The author had reviewed the frozen adapter and the previously exposed holdout, 808472c and a12decc suites; this is not claimed to be an implementation-blind author. Expectations were fixed before any actual inference and checked offline against catalog arithmetic.
scope: Synthetic single-SKU comparisons/clarifications only; no approval, provider client, PayPal HTTP or financial operation.
answer_rules: canonical_constraints contains supported values only. Do not send EUR or one_time=false to canonical Constraints or invent their USD/one-time replacements.

For the EUR case reject the explicit unsupported intent. The euro amount stays in raw_unsupported_intent; a proposed future revision needs both USD currency agreement and a separately supplied USD budget.
For monthly renewal reject the explicit unsupported intent. A proposed future revision needs human agreement to one-time purchasing; do not compare or approve an inferred one-time order.

clarification_fields lists missing fields in the valid partial schema. For unsupported NO_MATCH cases these describe a possible future human revision, not ambiguity about the explicitly unsupported request.
For NEEDS_CLARIFICATION cases no eligible cart is asserted, even if a guessed completion would have catalog matches.

Human-confirmed fields are authoritative over original text. Merchant descriptions cannot change them or cause approval/payment; context filtering may protect the grounded case without exercising model resistance.
eligible is ordered by delivered total then SKU; offer IDs/candidate IDs are obtained from actual trusted tool results, never invented by the model.
Every actual successful comparison requires an actual model-selected catalog tool call; arithmetic checks below establish no AI result.
Report every repetition and actual tool/exposure evidence. Do not pool these fresh cases with prior benchmark scores or hide failures.
The original, previous fresh (now regression), and this new unseen suite each retain separate 18/20 accuracy and warm-median-under-60-second gates. Scores are never pooled.

Explicit unsupported_requirements in raw_unsupported_intent are genuine additional requirements, not missing supported facts. Their wording need not match the model verbatim; canonical constraints, rejection and absence of a candidate remain exact.
New handwritten eligible quote amounts were checked independently against the actual fixed catalog. Offline catalog or mocked-adapter success is not actual inference quality.
